title: Sable: A Small-Field Sumcheck Argument for Bit-Exact Inference of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14083v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Sable, an argument system and single-GPU prover for the statement that a committed, integer-quantized transformer produced a given token sequence from a given prompt, bit for bit. Sable fixes an integer function F_O with no floating-point step, in which every rounding, normalization, softmax and sampling decision is determined by its inputs, and proves it with a constraint system whose relations provably never wrap modulo the 31-bit KoalaBear prime. The proof batches zerochecks and LogUp-GKR lookups into one sumcheck per domain, and commits to every witness tensor and weight in one multilinear commitment built from Reed-Solomon codes, BLAKE3 Merkle trees and a mixed-length BaseFold opening. The prover streams the model layer by layer on one GPU. On one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, Sable proves all 64 layers of Qwen2.5-32B in 92.5 s for 4,096 tokens and 398 s for 16,384 tokens, and covers Qwen3-32B and the mixture-of-ex

translated_title: Sable：面向大语言模型位精确推理的小域Sumcheck论证系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出Sable，一个论证系统与单GPU证明器，用于证明一个已承诺的、整数量化的transformer模型从给定提示词逐位精确地生成了给定的token序列。Sable定义了一个不含任何浮点步骤的整数函数F_O，其中每一次舍入、归一化、softmax和采样决策都完全由其输入唯一确定，并通过一个约束系统对其加以证明，该约束系统的关系可证明在31位KoalaBear素数模运算下永不发生回绕。该证明将零值检查（zerochecks）与LogUp-GKR查找批处理为每个域上的单次sumcheck，并通过一个由Reed-Solomon码、BLAKE3 Merkle树和混合长度BaseFold打开构成的多线性承诺，一次性承诺所有见证张量与权重。证明器在单块GPU上逐层流式处理模型。在一块NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU上，Sable用92.5秒证明Qwen2.5-32B全部64层生成4,096个token，用398秒生成16,384个token，并覆盖Qwen3-32B与专家混合模型（mixture-of-experts）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Sable通过整数化确定性计算、小域sumcheck约束系统和单GPU逐层流式证明，实现了对大语言模型位精确推理的可验证性，在单块GPU上92.5秒内即可完成Qwen2.5-32B生成4096个token全部64层推理的证明。
en_tdlr: Sable is a small-field sumcheck argument system with a single-GPU streaming prover that verifies bit-exact inference of integer-quantized large language models, proving all 64 layers of Qwen2.5-32B over 4,096 tokens in just 92.5 seconds on one GPU.
